description: Generate a CV (also called a resume — terms interchangeable in this MCP) tailored to a specific job description. Optionally persists and returns a structured export descriptor: data.export.url (long signed download URL), data.export.short_url (chat-client-friendly short URL — new in v0.3.0), expires_at, content_type, size_bytes, filename. Set export_format to "docx" (default) or "pdf" — both formats route through the same /d/[code] short-URL flow. Use get_cv_download_url to mint a fresh short URL after the original expires; the re-mint preserves the original format (no cross-format re-render). Note: MCP-generated PDFs always render with contentType='standard' and length='3_page' regardless of what variation you previewed in the browser UI — the MCP layer does not expose those knobs in v0.4.0. To get a different variation, change the variation in the browser UI and use its Export PDF button. PDFs render with all sections visible; if you toggled sections off in the browser UI, that state does not propagate to MCP PDFs.

content_type.description: Defaults to natural; ats also supported.

cv_profile_id.description: Optional CV profile id (from /api/v2/candidate-profiles). Defaults to first available.

export_format.description: Export format. 'docx' (default) or 'pdf'. PDF path reuses the same Chunk C.1 short-URL flow as docx (same /d/[code] redirect, same cv_short_links table) — your returned data.export.short_url just resolves to the PDF instead. NOTE: format is fixed at generation time; there is no cross-format on-demand re-render. To convert a previously-generated CV to a different format, call rewrite_cv_for_job again with the desired export_format.

paper_size.description: Save-side paper size. Defaults to letter.

persist.description: If true, persist and call export.

template.description: Save-side template (e.g. tech). Defaults to tech.

template_type.description: CV template (e.g. modern, tech). Defaults to modern.

name: rewrite_cv_for_job
